department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: December 31 for full consideration for financial support for the following fall.
deadline.quote: the application deadlines are December 31st for the subsequent fall semester

gre_general.value: GRE is optional; if sent, the department lists minimum scores 160 Q / 150 V / 3.0 AW.

funding.value: Page says PhD admission depends on availability of funding

entry_route.value: The department's PhD standard asks for a GPA of 3.5+ in an M.S. in civil/environmental engineering or related; the PhD is described as 3+ years beyond the M.S.
entry_route.quote: A GPA of at least 3.5 (out of 4.0) or equivalent in an M.S. degree program in civil and/or environmental engineering or a related discipline.

also.quote: typically involves at least 3 years of study beyond the M.S.
